claude_proposed_widenings.name: ignore_web_restrictions
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item grants deterministic immunity/traversal behavior for webs that is not modeled by resistance, condition immunity, speed grants, or any existing terrain-facing effect atom.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can't be caught in webs of any sort and can move through webs as if they were Difficult Terrain.
